sampack_emitweaks.configuration.title: SamPack EMI Tweaks
Item columns in the creative inventory (vanilla: 9). A wider inventory also fits more tabs per row. Applies the next time the inventory is opened.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.rows.too: Item rows in the creative inventory, not counting the hotbar (vanilla: 5). Applies the next time the inventory is opened.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.fit_to_s: Use fewer columns and rows (never fewer than vanilla) when the window is too small for the configured size.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.default_: Icon size in pixels when /emitweaks export or update_icons is given none.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.max_shee: Largest width and height of one sheet, in pixels. 2048 at 32px holds 4096 icons. Also capped at what the GPU supports.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.icons_pe: How many icons are rendered each frame. Higher is faster, until the progress screen stutters.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.include_: Also write each stack's display name into meta.json.
